# Guides / Plugins / Plugins / Content

> v6.6 documentation section. Applicability within this branch is unknown unless a linked page says otherwise.

[Branch index](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/llms.txt)

## Pages

- [Add CMS Block](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/cms/add-cms-block.md): Add CMS Block: This guide will teach you how to create your very own CMS block with your plugin.
- [Add CMS Element](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/cms/add-cms-element.md): Add CMS Element: This article will teach you how to create a new CMS element via plugin.

- [Add Custom Sitemap Entries](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/sitemap/add-custom-sitemap-entries.md): Add Custom Sitemap Entries: Of course Shopware comes with a sitemap generation feature, including products and categories, as well as some more URLs.
- [Add Data to CMS Element](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/cms/add-data-to-cms-elements.md): Add Data to CMS Element: When creating custom CMS elements, you sometimes want to use more complex data types than text or boolean values, e.g. other entities such as media or products. In those cases you can implement a custom CmsElementResolve
- [Add Data to Mails](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/mail/add-data-to-mails.md): Add Data to Mails: The mail templates in Shopware have access to a given set of data, e.g. the customer data, the order data, etc. Sometimes you want add your custom entity to that data set though, so you can use this data in your mail tem
- [Add Mail Templates](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/mail/add-mail-template.md): Add Mail Templates: You can add new mail templates to Shopware by using the Administration. However, you might want to ship a mail template with your plugin, so using the Administration is no option.
- [CMS](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/cms.md): CMS: In general, Shopware CMS creates and manages content using blocks and elements.
- [Content](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content.md): Content: Content feature in Shopware encompasses the essential capabilities related to managing and enhancing content within the e-commerce platform, including content management, email management, SEO optimization, sitemap gener
- [Implementing your own stock storage](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/stock/implementing-your-own-stock-storage.md): Implementing your own stock storage: Shopware stores stock as simple integer values in the product table. If you need a more advanced stock management system or would like to write the stock alterations to a different system, you can implement your own stoc
- [Loading Stock Information from a Different Source](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/stock/loading-stock-information-from-different-source.md): Loading Stock Information from a Different Source: If Shopware is not the source of truth for your stock data, you can customize the stock loading process and provide your data from a third-party source.
- [Mail](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/mail.md): Mail: Shopware Mail offers the ability to add mail data and configure mail templates for various email communications within the e-commerce platform. You can add relevant mail data such as transactional emails, order notificat
- [Media](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/media.md): Media: Shopware Media offers the ability to add media file extensions and prevent the deletion of media files within the e-commerce platform.
- [Modify Sitemap Entries](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/sitemap/modify-sitemap-entries.md): Modify Sitemap Entries: You might have had a look at our guide about adding custom sitemap entries,
- [Prevent Deletion of Media Files Referenced in your Plugins](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/media/prevent-deletion-of-media-files-referenced-in-your-plugins.md): Prevent Deletion of Media Files Referenced in your Plugins: The ability to prevent Media entities from being deleted is available since Shopware 6.5.1.0.
- [Reading and Writing Stock](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/stock/reading-writing-stock.md): Reading and Writing Stock: Shopware stores the current stock level alongside the product, this guide will help you when you want to read and write that value.
- [Remote Thumbnail Generation](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/media/remote-thumbnail-generation.md): Remote Thumbnail Generation: This feature is available starting with Shopware version 6.6.4.0
- [Remove Sitemap Entries](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/sitemap/remove-sitemap-entries.md): Remove Sitemap Entries: This guide covers how to remove URLs from the sitemap.
- [SEO](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/seo.md): SEO: The Shopware SEO feature offers the ability to add custom SEO URLs to optimize the search engine visibility of the e-commerce platform.
- [Sitemap](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/sitemap.md): Sitemap: Shopware Sitemap offers the ability to add sitemaps and modify sitemap entries within the e-commerce platform.
- [Stock](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.6/guides/plugins/plugins/content/stock.md): Stock: The stock management system is available from Shopware 6.5.5.0. It is only enabled if the shop owner has enabled the \STOCKHANDLING\ feature flag.
